shortDescription: Muted expectations for Swiss consumer-price growth leave the Swiss National Bank in a "comfortable" position, President Martin Schlegel told SRF, according to Bloomberg.

title: Swiss Inflation Leaves SNB in a Comfortable Position, Schlegel Says
